name: Movemental (React + Vite)
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 22.22.2 >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm use 22.22.2 >/dev/null; node -v; npm ci

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22.22.2 >/dev/null; npm run dev
